in_hebrew.name: Peg
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Peg הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from Old English pegge, meaning 'stick' or 'foot'. This name has been used in various contexts throughout history, including as a surname and as a given name. In the context of a Christian name, Peg may symbolize stability, foundation, or support.
